data.title: Jadeel
data.about:
Madinat Jumeirah Living, an exclusive high-end collection of opulent freehold apartments located opposite Burj Al Arab, in Jumeirah, Dubai. This is the first opportunity for you to own a property in this community, as it was previously only open to citizens of UAE. 

Offering exquisite views of the sea and Burj Al Arab, MJL provides its residents direct footbridge link to the beautiful resort of Madinat Jumeirah. An environmentally-friendly community, these homes offer a safe haven for its residents and it is the ideal place to come home to peace and tranquillity.

characteristics_module.title: A Home That Speaks for Itself
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• First Freehold Property in Jumeirah
  • Dubai’s key & most posh location
  • Magnificent views of Burj Al Arab
  • 1 – 4 BR with full views of the Burj Al Arab
  • 1 BR starting at AED 1.39 million
  • Pay 50% during construction and 50% on handover
  • Handover: May 2025

location_tile.title: Nestled in Madinat Jumeirah
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
Madinat Jumeirah Living is located close to the major malls and business areas. It is also very close to popular beaches, restaurants, and lounges.

  • 05 mins – Burj al Arab
  • 05 mins – Mall of Emirates
  • 15 mins – Dubai Marina
  • 15 mins – Palm Jumeirah
  • 16 mins – Downtown Dubai
  • 20 mins – Dubai International Airport
